column1: # Road fire signals, read by lint rule RR (crates/gravity/lint/rules/rr_road_registry.py). One row per (road, fire): a name
# a `fires::fire` / `fires::fire_shared` site records when the road engages, so a fire census attributes the statement to
# the road. Keyed by road and fire name, never by file and line. A road on by default needs a row whose fire its code
# fires (RR fails a row of a declared road whose fire nothing fires). A fire named <road> or <road>.<form> is the road's
# own; any other name is mapped only after reading its site: it fires where the road engaged, never where it declined.
# Rows in any order (merge=union in .gitattributes); RR fails a duplicate.
